services.desc: OPEN TO THE PUBLIC, EVERYONE ENTERING AreaBFE MUST PURCHASE ENTRY, FILL OUT OUR WAIVER AND COMPLETE UTAH OHV COURSE This 3.5‑hour Hell’s Revenge Sunset U‑Drive tour puts guests behind the wheel on Moab’s most legendary off‑road slickrock trail just as the desert light is at its best. After a brief orientation, the convoy follows the guide onto the sandstone “fins,” where UTVs climb smoothly up steep slickrock, ease down controlled descents, and travel along narrow ridgelines with big desert sky and soft evening light all around. As the route winds deeper into Hell’s Revenge, a series of iconic obstacles and features are tackled at a relaxed, deliberate pace, keeping the experience thrilling
